svg.aria-label: Sequence: artifacts are copied to the workload VM through the jumpbox, pip and apt fail because there is no route out, wheels are unpacked with zipfile, the script writes a log to blob storage, runs Qwen 0.5B on CPU, reads the log back and uploads the AI report, all through the private endpoint.
svg.title: Sequence: artifacts are copied to the workload VM through the jumpbox, pip and apt fail because there is no route out, wheels are unpacked with zipfile, the script writes a log to blob storage, runs Qwen 0.5B on CPU, reads the log back and uploads the AI report, all through the private endpoint.

g.text: every blob call goes to the
dns zone. public access is off.
